measured.fixture: 8 contrast candidates over one stubbed page, both arms running the real exported runVisualContrastFallback

change: screenshot-contrast.mjs: captureVisualContrastCandidate returns {status: pass|fail|unresolved, reason} instead of a finding or null, reusing the vocabulary analyzeVisualContrastCandidate already speaks
registry/antipatterns.mjs: new advisory rule contrast-coverage, so the denominator rides the findings array without becoming a failure
detect-url.mjs: runVisualContrastFallback tallies both arms and emits one coverage note, including on the --no-pixel early return
structural_facts: findings.mjs mints exactly one record shape and no skipped/checked vocabulary existed anywhere in the detector CLI or entrypoint, so the conflation was forced by the record shape rather than chosen at the call site

the browser-side analyzer already spoke pass/fail/unresolved+reason; the pixel fallback discarded it and detect-url.mjs used status only to build browserResolvedSelectors - the vocabulary existed one layer up and was dropped crossing the boundary

the detector that gates this project's design quality is outside every one of the project's own gates: eslint.config ignores .claude/skills/**, and ALL_TEST_GLOBS covers lib/ features/ scripts/ packages/*/src/ only - so no lint, test or typecheck reaches it
limitation: the coverage note is suppressed by --no-advisory, so the denominator can still be switched off; the corpus technique wants it inseparable from the numerator
not_measured: the real rate at which selectors go stale on a live page - puppeteer is absent, so no browser arm was run

measured.instrument: vitest unit + injected counting fetchImpl on MonitorClient.fetchPeriods, identical both arms
measured.metric: upstream requests issued per terminal refusal

change: refusal-class.ts: new pure classifier over a closed disjoint set (ok/pressure/declined/absent/broken) plus RefusedError naming its class and isTerminalRefusal
monitor.ts fetchJsonWithRetry: classify before choosing a response; a terminal class throws once and the catch declines to retry what it already ruled terminal
structural_facts: the defect was structural, not a typo: `throw new Error(!res.ok)` fired INSIDE the try, so the same loop catch that exists for network errors retried every 4xx - a host that DECLINED was hammered exactly as hard as a transient 503

monitor.ts alone had it; dataor.ts:49 and smlouvy.ts:331 `return res` for non-ok instead of throwing, so the identical-looking retry loops behave differently at the one point that matters, and nothing in the tree names that difference
all three adapters key retry on the two literal codes 429/503, so `declined` vs `broken` was never a distinction the ingest layer could express - the caller receives a bare status embedded in prose
limitation: only monitor.ts is converted; dataor and smlouvy return the response to callers that re-derive the class from res.status, so the vocabulary is not yet shared across the three adapters
not_measured: whether any live upstream has actually rate-limited or banned this client - no production request log was read
